top_signals.title: Netanyahu, Zelenskyy come to DC for Graham's funeral, meetings with Trump amid wars
top_signals.summary: The funeral for Sen. Lindsey Graham is bringing world leaders to Washington at a time when many are eager to meet with President Donald Trump amid wars.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Tokyo to boost financial support for overseas oil pipeline investments
top_signals.summary: The government will consider measures including risk-capital fundingr to promote Japanese firms' participation in such projects, a recently released document shows.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
